title: Sum of Factorials of Digits

content.outputFormat: Sum of Factorial of each digits

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Compute sum of factorials of each digit (Krishnamurthy / Strong number component).

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    facts = [1, 1, 2, 6, 24, 120, 720, 5040, 40320, 362880]
    print(sum(facts[int(c)] for c in toks[0]))
if __name__ == "__main__": main()
